document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You see barrel-shaped creatures, stump-like, like the ones in 
the mosaics. They lie silent and still under thick ice; frozen 
and timeless. Make a Sanity roll and lose 0/1D6 Sanity points. 
Moving forward you seem to be going in circles! Return to 555.
